mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "SUPPORT" ( SUPPORT_NO, SUPPORT_TITLE, EMAIL, SUPPORT_CONTENT, SUPPORT_DATE, SUPPORT_STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_SUPPORT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{title}, #{email}, #{content}, DEFAULT, DEFAULT )
mapper.select: SELECT SUPPORT_NO "supportNo", SUPPORT_TITLE "supportTitle", EMAIL "email", SUPPORT_CONTENT "supportContent", TO_CHAR(SUPPORT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') "supportDate", SUPPORT_STATUS "supportStatus", ANSWER_CONTENT "answerContent" FROM SUPPORT ORDER BY SUPPORT_NO DESC
